resources.string: This Agent has stopped. Resume runs it again in a terminal on its computer.
Whatever runs in it stops. This can\'t be undone.
Agents that have stopped left these terminals. Closing them ends the shells in them; the Agents\' conversations stay, and Resume opens a new terminal.
